verses.text: A psalm of David. LORD, who can stay in your sacred tent? Who can live on your holy hill?
The person who lives a blameless life, does what is right, and speaks the truth from the heart.
That person does not spread lies about others, does not harm a friend, and does not insult a neighbour.
That person looks down on those who are evil, but honours those who respect the LORD. That person keeps a promise even when it hurts, and does not change it.
That person lends money without charging interest, and does not take a bribe to hurt innocent people. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
